proposals.expected_signal: Improves frozen full-sort NDCG@10 by separating high-degree popularity flow from true preference propagation, yielding strongest gains on mid-activity users while remaining comparable in training cost
proposals.failure_mode: Attention-style message transforms may overfit sparse local motifs on ML-1M and collapse toward popularity-weighted smoothing, producing no gain over lighter graph propagation baselines
proposals.hypothesis: A structurally distinct graph model that applies learned message transforms on user-item edges, while constraining edge weights by node-degree-normalized trust coefficients, can preserve useful higher-order collaborative signals without the oversmoothing typical of simpler propagation models
